sections.heading: Learning to drive: first part — C2
sections.markdown:
FACT_ID: sec05-R01 | anchor: A37
The handbook directs a left-turning driver at green to wait for a turning opportunity; if heavy traffic prevents one, it describes placing the vehicle's front slightly beyond the stop bar, yielding to pedestrians and opposing traffic, and turning when safe. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec05-R02 | anchor: A37
Enter the intended turning lane before the turn and remain in that lane until the turn is finished. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec05-R03 | anchor: A37
A right turn at red is allowed unless a sign forbids it, after a complete stop and after all crossing vehicles and pedestrians clear the intersection. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec05-R04 | anchor: A37
A left turn at red is allowed only from the far-left lane of a one-way street into another one-way street, unless a posted sign prohibits that turn. [A37]
Source: [A37 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0037]

FACT_ID: sec05-R05 | anchor: A38
When a light changes to green, wait briefly before entering and do not assume that other road users will obey their signals or yield. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R06 | anchor: A38
Even at green, wait before the intersection until traffic beyond it moves enough to let you clear it without blocking crossing traffic. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R07 | anchor: A38
Before turning onto a road, verify a clear path and a gap large enough to cross, enter the proper lane and accelerate to traffic speed. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R08 | anchor: A38
Do not turn or pull out in front of an approaching signaling vehicle without enough clear distance, because its driver may turn later or have left the signal on. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R09 | anchor: A38
After stopping where cross traffic is hidden, edge forward to obtain a view before entering the intersection. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R10 | anchor: A38
In a roundabout or traffic circle, vehicles move counterclockwise around a raised central island. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R11 | anchor: A38
Check direction signs before entering a roundabout because lane changes are not allowed inside it. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R12 | anchor: A38
Reduce speed before entering a roundabout or traffic circle. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R13 | anchor: A38
Yield to vehicles already circulating before entering a roundabout or traffic circle. [A38]
Source: [A38 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0038]

FACT_ID: sec05-R14 | anchor: A39
Look left for circulating traffic and enter only when the lane is clear. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R15 | anchor: A39
After entering a roundabout, keep moving without stopping or changing lanes. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R16 | anchor: A39
Signal as you reach the appropriate roundabout exit and leave the circle. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R17 | anchor: A39
The handbook's listed roundabout pattern uses the first exit for a right turn. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R18 | anchor: A39
The handbook's listed roundabout pattern uses the second exit to continue straight. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R19 | anchor: A39
The handbook's listed roundabout pattern uses the third exit for a left turn. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R20 | anchor: A39
The handbook's listed roundabout pattern uses the fourth exit to reverse direction with a U-turn. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R21 | anchor: A39
Drive on the roadway's right half unless one of the stated exceptions applies. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R22 | anchor: A39
Passing a vehicle traveling in the same direction is a stated exception to the right-half roadway rule. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R23 | anchor: A39
A road divided into at least three marked lanes is a stated exception to the right-half roadway rule. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R24 | anchor: A39
A road designed and posted for one-way traffic is a stated exception to the right-half roadway rule. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R25 | anchor: A39
Police directions or a traffic-control device may direct travel outside the normal right half of the roadway. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R26 | anchor: A39
An obstruction may require driving left of center, but the driver must yield to oncoming traffic. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

FACT_ID: sec05-R27 | anchor: A39
On a road with at least four lanes, the handbook directs travel in the right lane and use of the lane immediately right of center for passing and left turns. [A39]
Source: [A39 -> src:rdmv-oh-d:ohio-department-of-public-safety-bureau-:handbook:pdf-0039]

Confusables: a permitted red-light turn still requires a complete stop and yielding; a green signal does not provide room beyond a blocked intersection. Mirrors and cameras supplement looking while backing. Mnemonic: search, position, signal, clear. Glossary: a roundabout is a circular intersection; following interval is the time gap behind the leading vehicle. These cues organize the cited statements only.
